title: Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o's birth chart
metaDescription: Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 14.4° Capricorn. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Five of the nine placements whose signs are settled fall in earth signs — at least half of what the unknown hour leaves certain. Earth signs hold the scheme’s slow end, where results are measured in what survives rather than what starts.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Measured rather than labelled, the Sun holds 14.4° Capricorn: the second decan, whose classical sub-ruler is Venus. A earth sign, read here in its second face.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Mercury holds 0.9° Capricorn, Venus holds 7.3° Capricorn, Mars holds 11.1° Pisces — in the old shorthand, a mind that trusts the measured and the checked; taste for the substantial and the lasting; drive that moves on certainty and current.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Saturn and Pluto: 0.1° from an exact trine. A trine is an open channel. The two cooperate without being asked, which is exactly why it is easy to spend and easy to take for granted. Behind it, Mars sextile Uranus at 1.3°, and Mercury square Saturn at 1.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: None of the seven classical planets falls in a sign the old scheme marks as strong or stretched. Worth saying plainly rather than leaving out: there is no ready-made verdict from the dignity table here, and the chart’s weight sits in its angles instead.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements earth 5, water 3, air 1; modalities cardinal 4, mutable 3, fixed 2. An earth emphasis reads as patience with material reality — slow hands, durable results. No settled placement falls in fire — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Mercury, Uranus, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Aquarius into Pisces during that day at the birthplace, travelling 12.4° between one midnight and the next. The hour would decide it; no hour was recorded. The reading keeps the question open rather than flipping a coin dressed as astrology.
